scientific_hypothesis: Exact TARGET-normalized CTC sequence likelihood distinguishes a single explicit INSERT hypothesis from canonical KEEP more reliably than greedy INSERT_IN_DECODED.

r4_4c2_checkpoint.selection_metric: lowest R4 validation PER, then higher deletion F1, then earlier epoch

frozen_model_contract.architecture: R4-4C2 CNN 16->32->64->96, frequency mean, one packed bidirectional GRU with hidden_size 96, Linear(192,41)
frozen_model_contract.phone_vocabulary: the frozen ordered 40-phone canonical R3/R4 inventory at indices 0-39
frozen_model_contract.audio_and_features: exact R4-4C2 full MFA word span, mono 16 kHz, 64-bin Slaney log-mel, FFT 512, 400-sample Hann window, 160-sample hop, per-word max-relative dB, temporal downsampling x2
frozen_model_contract.sequence_likelihood: exact torch.nn.CTCLoss sum over valid CTC alignments
frozen_model_contract.permitted_new_logic: deterministic KEEP/INSERT construction, exact scoring, argmax, speaker-LOSO threshold calibration, and reporting outside the neural model

train_word_population.population_rule: Reuse the frozen R5-0 runtime-evaluable TRAIN word reconstruction: unique manual-word containment, nonempty canonical expected sequence, no unresolved/malformed row in the word, and a reliable frozen MFA word span.
train_word_population.accounting_requirement: All 423 source clean additions remain in data accounting. Events not entering word scoring because of missing word containment, empty expected sequence, unresolved co-occurring evidence, or unavailable runtime word span must be reported by reason; they are not silently discarded.
train_word_population.positive_word: at least one frozen V4 clean addition event in the eligible word
train_word_population.negative_word: zero frozen V4 clean addition events in the eligible word
train_word_population.mixed_positive_policy: retain addition-positive words that also contain substitution, deletion, or multiple additions and report each flag separately
train_word_population.correct_only_negative: zero additions, zero substitutions, zero deletions, and every eligible expected-phone relation is correct
train_word_population.substitution_negative: zero additions and at least one substitution; may overlap deletion-containing negative
train_word_population.deletion_negative: zero additions and at least one deletion; may overlap substitution-containing negative

expected_sequence.construction: canonical expected phones from resolved correct, substitution, and deletion rows in frozen source order; addition rows do not enter E

exact_score.best_insert: BEST_INSERT=max over all legal (b,p) of INSERT(b,p)
exact_score.decision_dtype: float64 after CTCLoss output is converted from the frozen inference implementation
exact_score.reason: KEEP has target length N>=1 and every single-INSERT candidate has target length N+1>=2; the inherited max(length,1) denominator is therefore unique and finite.

argmax_ties_and_sequence_equivalence.known_equivalence: Different boundaries can yield the same target sequence when p equals phones in an adjacent repeated-phone run; their exact CTC scores are necessarily identical.
argmax_ties_and_sequence_equivalence.policy: Do not claim the posterior distinguished equivalent boundaries. Apply the frozen tie and report total candidates, unique target sequences, duplicate-equivalent candidates, and true events whose boundary belongs to a multi-boundary equivalence class.
argmax_ties_and_sequence_equivalence.memoization: Identical target sequences may share one computed likelihood only if every candidate identity is restored before deterministic argmax; score semantics must remain exact.

ctc_alignability_and_numerical_guard.minimum_ctc_steps: len(H)+count of adjacent identical target labels
ctc_alignability_and_numerical_guard.pre_score_audit: audit KEEP and every INSERT candidate against encoder length T
ctc_alignability_and_numerical_guard.required: zero theoretically unalignable candidates and finite returned scores
ctc_alignability_and_numerical_guard.failure_action: stop before threshold calibration and classify as an implementation/protocol technical failure; do not use zero_infinity output as an artificial high score and do not change the score formula

speaker_loso.score_prediction_rule: A>=theta predicts addition; A<theta predicts non-addition
speaker_loso.threshold_candidates: np.nextafter(min(U),-np.inf), every sorted unique finite calibration A value U, np.nextafter(max(U),+np.inf)
selection_precedence: lower calibration false-addition rate on correct-only words
speaker_loso.no_finite_score_action: technical stop before held-out prediction; no threshold approximation
speaker_loso.prediction_freeze: persist each held-out speaker prediction before proceeding to the next fold
speaker_loso.aggregate: concatenate all 12 held-out predictions once to produce OOF metrics

robust_threshold.name: ROBUST_THETA
robust_threshold.derivation_condition: derive only if all six R5-1 development gates pass and all 12 fold thresholds are finite
robust_threshold.formula: ordinary float64 median of the 12 fold thresholds; for 12 values, arithmetic mean of the 6th and 7th sorted values in float64
robust_threshold.future_use: may be evaluated only in a separately authorized, already-described-as-iterative VALIDATION protocol

word_metrics.binary_macro_f1: unweighted mean of non-addition F1 and addition F1
word_metrics.balanced_accuracy: unweighted mean of non-addition recall and addition recall

report: score distributions for true addition, correct-only, substitution-containing negative, deletion-containing negative
Pearson and Spearman score association with expected length and word duration

event_metrics.prediction_source: For a threshold-positive word, emit exactly the BEST_INSERT argmax phone and boundary; threshold-negative words emit no event.
event_metrics.true_events: all clean addition events in the eligible word, including every event in a multiple-addition word
event_metrics.exact_match: same word identity, canonical added-phone identity, and expected-sequence insertion boundary
event_metrics.matching: deterministic one-to-one multiset matching by word identity, boundary, then phone; at most one predicted event per word
event_metrics.multiple_addition_consequence: unmatched additional true events are false negatives; do not collapse the word to one true event

future_result_classification.R5_1_INSERTION_HYPOTHESIS_SCORING_NOT_CO: one or more development gates fail

on_any_gate_failure: do not add another score family or insertion penalty
do not tune by phone, boundary, duration, or speaker
do not rerun with another checkpoint
stop_rule.new_idea_requirement: a new named and preregistered research cycle

validation_policy.role: possible later iterative development transfer evaluation only
validation_policy.reason: the R4-4C2 checkpoint epoch was selected using these speakers' validation PER

test_policy.role: candidate independent final confirmation split after development and a dedicated locked TEST preregistration
eligibility_requirements: required development and iterative validation gates pass

evidence_roles.current_VALIDATION: possible later iterative transfer evaluation only

forbidden: VALIDATION or TEST access during R5-1 development
